We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied first three templates. For template 29646, we got three possible precursors (list of three SMILES). Need to choose one path that continues through the sequence.

The result of apply_template gave three possible outcomes (precursor sets). Actually each tuple seems to be a set of precursors? For template 29646, result: (('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))

So three possible single-precursor molecules (maybe after disconnection). We need to apply next template 1914389 to the product of previous step? Actually retrosynthesis: start from target, apply template 29646 to get precursor(s). Then apply 1914389 to each precursor? The order must be as given. So we need a chain of 5 reactions, each using the specified template, resulting in final precursors (starting materials). So we need to select a path where each template is applicable sequentially.

We applied 1914389 to the first precursor from 29646 (the one with silyl group). It gave two possible outcomes: a tuple of two SMILES: ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC')

So applying 1914389 gave two precursors (maybe a disconnection). Good.

Now we need to apply template 1914390 to each of those? Actually the next template is 1914390. We attempted to apply to the first precursor (the silyl-containing). It returned empty, meaning not applicable. Maybe we need to apply 1914390 to the second precursor (the ester?). Let's try.
